data.name: Lumen Current User Re-Engagement: Product Photo Polish

brief.audience: Current Lumen users in high-value markets who have already used AI editing, especially people improving product photos for selling, listings, or small-business content.
brief.hook: Bring them back when photo quality matters: one tap to keep product shots bright, sharp, and ready to post, with unlimited editing unlocked at the moment they hit the AI limit.
avoid: Onboarding paywall push: 10.9% of payers refund, $6.55/user
why: Current users who reach the AI edit limit convert at 47.5% and generate $30.74/user with 2.3% refunds.
People making 5-7 AI edits on day one pay at 33% and generate $15.47/user with 30.3% revenue share.
The product_photos goal is the strongest onboarding goal at 22.9% paid and $10.32/user with 6.3% refunds.
The product_photos × apple_search_ads segment reaches 39.5% paid and $19.61/user with 3.8% refunds.
Apple Search Ads is the strongest paid channel at 32.1% paid and $15.03/user, while google_uac adds scale with 4526 users and $8.64/user.
